status: Policy gradient methods complete — variance reduction validated
key_finding: Three policy gradient variants on MountainCar demonstrate variance hierarchy: REINFORCE (variance 8067, collapsed), REINFORCE+Baseline (0.2, converged to -12.4), Actor-Critic (0.6, converged to -12.7). The advantage function A(s,a) = Q(s,a) - V(s) unifies all three — MC advantage exact but noisy, TD advantage approximate but stable. Policy gradients with linear features handle continuous state naturally unlike tabular methods.
